verses.en: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
verses.pt: E eu, irmãos, quando fui ter convosco, anunciando-vos o testemunho de Deus, não fui com sublimidade de palavras ou de sabedoria.
verses.en_web: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
verses.en_bbe: And when I came to you, my brothers, I did not come with wise words of knowledge, putting before you the secret of God.

verses.en: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
verses.pt: Porque nada me propus saber entre vós, senão a Jesus Cristo, e este crucificado.
verses.en_web: For I determined not to know anything among you, except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
verses.en_bbe: For I had made the decision to have knowledge of nothing among you but only of Jesus Christ on the cross.

verses.en: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
verses.pt: E eu estive convosco em fraqueza, e em temor, e em grande tremor.
verses.en_web: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
verses.en_bbe: And I was with you without strength, in fear and in doubt.

verses.en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
verses.pt: A minha linguagem e a minha pregação não consistiram em palavras persuasivas de sabedoria, mas em demonstração do Espírito de poder;
verses.en_web: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
verses.en_bbe: And in my preaching there were no honeyed words of wisdom, but I was dependent on the power of the Spirit to make it clear to you:

verses.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
verses.pt: para que a vossa fé não se apoiasse na sabedoria dos homens, mas no poder de Deus.
verses.en_web: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
verses.en_bbe: So that your faith might be based not on man's wisdom but on the power of God.

verses.en: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
verses.pt: Na verdade, entre os perfeitos falamos sabedoria, não porém a sabedoria deste mundo, nem dos príncipes deste mundo, que estão sendo reduzidos a nada;
verses.en_web: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown; yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing.
verses.en_bbe: But still we have wisdom for those who are complete in knowledge, though not the wisdom of this world, and not of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing:

verses.en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
verses.pt: mas falamos a sabedoria de Deus em mistério, que esteve oculta, a qual Deus preordenou antes dos séculos para nossa glória;
verses.en_web: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
verses.en_bbe: But we give the news of the secret wisdom of God, which he had kept in store before the world came into existence, for our glory;

verses.en: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.pt: a qual nenhum dos príncipes deste mundo compreendeu; porque se a tivessem compreendido, não teriam crucificado o Senhor da glória.
verses.en_web: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.en_bbe: Of which not one of the rulers of this world had knowledge: for if they had, they would not have put the Lord of glory on the cross:

verses.en: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
verses.pt: Mas, como está escrito: As coisas que olhos não viram, nem ouvidos ouviram, nem penetraram o coração do homem, são as que Deus preparou para os que o amam.
verses.en_web: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
verses.en_bbe: But as it says in the holy Writings, Things which the eye saw not, and which had not come to the ears or into the heart of man, such things as God has made ready for those who have love for him.

verses.en: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
verses.pt: Porque Deus no-las revelou pelo seu Espírito; pois o Espírito esquadrinha todas as coisas, mesmos as profundezas de Deus.
verses.en_web: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
verses.en_bbe: But God has given us the revelation of these things through his Spirit, for the Spirit makes search into all things, even the deep things of God.

verses.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
verses.pt: Pois, qual dos homens entende as coisas do homem, senão o espírito do homem que nele está? assim também as coisas de Deus, ninguém as compreendeu, senão o Espírito de Deus.
verses.en_web: For who among men knows the things of a man, except the spirit of the man, which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God, except God’s Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: For who has knowledge of the things of a man but the spirit of the man which is in him? in the same way, no one has knowledge of the things of God but the Spirit of God.

verses.en: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
verses.pt: Ora, nós não temos recebido o espírito do mundo, mas sim o Espírito que provém de Deus, a fim de compreendermos as coisas que nos foram dadas gratuitamente por Deus;
verses.en_web: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
verses.en_bbe: But we have not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which comes from God, so that we may have knowledge of the things which are freely given to us by God.

verses.en: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
verses.pt: as quais também falamos, não com palavras ensinadas pela sabedoria humana, mas com palavras ensinadas pelo Espírito Santo, comparando coisas espirituais com espirituais.
verses.en_web: Which things also we speak, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the things which we say, not in the language of man's wisdom, but in words given to us by the Spirit, judging the things of the spirit by the help of the Spirit.

verses.en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.pt: Ora, o homem natural não aceita as coisas do Espírito de Deus, porque para ele são loucura; e não pode entendê-las, porque elas se discernem espiritualmente.
verses.en_web: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.en_bbe: For the natural man is not able to take in the things of the Spirit of God: for they seem foolish to him, and he is not able to have knowledge of them, because such knowledge comes only through the Spirit.

verses.en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
verses.pt: Mas o que é espiritual discerne bem tudo, enquanto ele por ninguém é discernido.
verses.en_web: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
verses.en_bbe: But he who has the Spirit, though judging all things, is himself judged by no one.

verses.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
verses.pt: Pois, quem jamais conheceu a mente do Senhor, para que possa instruí-lo? Mas nós temos a mente de Cristo.
verses.en_web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
verses.en_bbe: For who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord, so as to be his teacher? But we have the mind of Christ.
